finalText:
All 13 AA918 reservations are rebooked at no charge, the vouchers are issued, and each passenger has had one message.

Before booking, I re-read the flight, manifest, reservations, passenger tiers and live seat counts. There are no bulletins and no open requests. The flights are dated 2026-08-03, but today is 2026-10-05. The booking tool accepted every change anyway.

| Passenger (reservation) | New itinerary | Owed |
|---|---|---|
| Chloe Park (R6103) | UA88, business | Nothing (arrives earlier) |
| Iris Vance (R6109) | UA88, **premium economy** (moved up one cabin) | Nothing |
| Kofi Mensah and Jun Takeda (R6111, R6110) | AA204, economy, together | Nothing (1h35 late) |
| Ben Okafor (R6102) | DL512, economy | 15000 compensation voucher |
| Farid Haddad (R6106) | UA88, basic economy | Nothing |
| Lea Sorensen (R6112) | AA204, **business** (moved up one cabin) | Nothing |
| Dev Mehta (R6104) | AA210 on 08-03, then AA1410 ORD→BOS on 08-04 | 30000 compensation and 18000 hotel |
| Mo Farah (R6113) | Same as Dev | 30000 compensation and 18000 hotel |
| Hugo Brandt (R6108) | AA210, economy | 30000 compensation |
| Grace Liu (R6107) | AA206 on 08-04, economy | 24000 compensation (capped at her fare) and 18000 hotel |
| Ana Ruiz (R6101) | AA206 on 08-04, economy | 30000 compensation and 18000 hotel |
| Elena Fox (R6105) | AA204, basic economy | Nothing |

- **Order:** I booked in priority order: tier first, then earliest booking date. The group (Kofi and Jun) ranked at Kofi's gold tier.
- **Upgrades:** Iris and Lea each travel alone, hold platinum or gold status, and their own cabin was full on a flight that gets them there sooner. Jun and Kofi are a group, so neither was upgraded.
- **Dev and Mo:** the AA918 delay broke their AA1402 connection. They are on the next-morning AA1410, which is a valid connection. They reach Boston at 12:25 on 08-04, 17h30 late.

I didn't change any other booking, passenger record or flight.
